402_interpretation: HTTP 402 is the unsigned x402 payment challenge, not an origin failure. It supplies payment terms in PAYMENT-REQUIRED and requires a wallet-signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE retry. No wallet or funds were available, so no signing, payment, delivery, or verification was attempted.
